name: [UPD 2] Anime Slots
desc:
16K LIKES FOR THE NEXT CODE!!!
10X LUCK EVENT!

What is Anime Slots?
-Press the Roll to spin for random Anime Auras!
-You can find items around the map to help roll better Auras
-Craft items to help boost your chances
-Fight Bosses to unlock exclusive rewards

Note: This game is inspired by the game Sol's RNG, but with an Anime twist and unique features.

Make sure to join the community for updates and sneakpeeks!
